title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE RAID TEXT WORK
why: The card was stamped v21.73 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the first raid text builds of 2026-10-09: two message rows, wrapping, and warnings that stay up; the rest are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names the raid text work.
